name: Online ancient coin appraisal lecture starts, combining data analysis and machine learning to explore new methods
description: Starting March 2, the weekly Sunday morning online lecture series on ancient coin appraisal officially began. In the first lecture, Ye Mingxuan examined his personal collection with a scientific methodology and identified two counterfeits he had treasured for years. One of them even contained historical materials on currency circulation during the Anti-Japanese War. His appraisal ability made a qualitative leap. During a break in the lecture on March 16, fellow collector Zhao Jianguo mentioned the idea of using machine learning for ancient coin dating. Ye Mingxuan immediately realized the potential of combining Python with collecting, registered on GitHub on the spot, and created the "Coin Chain" project folder. After the lecture on March 23, Zhao Jianguo sent a private message pointing out that his appraisal relied too much on hand feel and suggesting incorporating data-driven analysis. Ye Mingxuan then began to conceive a plan to build an ancient coin feature database with Python.

name: Trapped unexpectedly in the office building elevator; scary but no harm done
description: At 8:15 a.m. on Wednesday, March 19, as Ye Mingxuan was taking the elevator in his company's office building as usual, the elevator suddenly shook and stopped between the 15th and 16th floors. He and three colleagues in the elevator were trapped for about 30 minutes and were finally rescued by property maintenance workers who manually released the brake. The close call delayed his morning work and was the first time in his life he had encountered such a low-probability accident. Afterwards, he posted a joking status on Moments: “Checking in for the elevator scare.”

name: Collaborated with collector friend Zhao Jianguo to compile Tianjin Modern Machine-Struck Coin Anti-Counterfeiting and Variety Notes and published it on a forum.
description: On June 10, the three-month online lecture series on ancient coin identification officially came to an end. Ye Mingxuan and the lecturer Zhao Jianguo systematically organized the cases, high-definition rubbings, and variety characteristics accumulated during the period, and co-authored Notes on Anti-Counterfeiting and Varieties of Modern Machine-Struck Coins in Tianjin. The handbook covers common types such as Baoyin and Longyang, including hidden marks, edge teeth, and silver oxidation patterns, and is accompanied by rust-color distribution charts initially fitted by Ye Mingxuan using Python. On June 18, after the handbook was posted on the Huaxia Collection Network forum, it quickly gained over 10,000 reads and hundreds of interactions from collector friends. Zhao Jianguo praised on WeChat its new perspective of scientific identification.

Facing the empty workstation and the pile of handover emails, Ye Mingxuan felt professional loneliness for the first time, but with the ISTJ's characteristic sense of order, he quickly organized a project handover checklist and a module transition plan. A week later, Zhou Tao privately invited Ye Mingxuan to dinner and formally invited him to join his smart warehousing startup as a technical co-founder. After returning home, Ye Mingxuan used Excel to carefully calculate the monthly mortgage payment, the minimum cost of living, and the income uncertainty during the early startup phase. He realized he could not afford the risk of leaving his job at the time, so he politely declined the invitation, but promised to provide technical support in his spare time. When his father Ye Jianguo learned of this, he praised him for prioritizing stability and not being rash.

He knew nothing about classical music, but he didn't want to waste the tickets, so he invited his father Ye Jianguo to go with him. He tried hard to listen throughout the performance; although his mind wandered a bit midway, he was inexplicably moved by the deep melody in the final movement. name: Setbacks in mentoring a new hire and a deep conversation with his father led him to understand the patience required for passing on knowledge.
description: On September 11, 2025, Ye Mingxuan was physically and mentally exhausted from explaining things multiple times to new hires without results, and returned home feeling low after work. During dinner, he confided his troubles to his father, Ye Jianguo. His father recalled the days when he was scolded as an apprentice in his youth and said, 'Passing on a craft is passing on patience.' After hearing this, Ye Mingxuan understood the responsibility and tolerance in passing on skills, and his anxiety about mentoring was relieved.

subevent.name: Mentored new staff with repeated explanations to no avail
subevent.description: During the technical breakthrough, Ye Mingxuan tried many times to explain mechanical design principles to the newcomer, but the newcomer was never able to understand, which left him physically and mentally exhausted and feeling frustrated.

name: Diagnosed with lumbar muscle strain due to lower back pain and completed physical therapy and rehabilitation exercises.
description: On April 11, Ye Mingxuan felt lower back pain and decided to see a doctor. On the morning of April 13, Dr. Liu Wentao at Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center diagnosed him with mild lumbar muscle strain. He received his first low-frequency pulse physiotherapy that day and made appointments for two follow-up sessions. He completed the second and third physiotherapy sessions on April 20 and 27 respectively. In addition, following the doctor's advice, from April 14 he started stretching during work breaks and added core muscle exercises.

name: Preliminary preparations and discussion for the family home purchase.
description: Ye Mingxuan carried out preliminary preparations and communication for the family's home purchase: on February 3, he collected and screened housing listings in Xiqing District online in advance; on the evening of February 4, he held a meeting with his parents. His mother was worried about the monthly payment and opposed a commercial loan, while his father rationally planned the down payment and repayment plan. Ye Mingxuan presented the information and explained, and for the first time felt the gap in risk perception between the two generations. After the meeting, he worked late into the night to create a housing project comparison table and financial calculations; during the lunch break on February 5, he consulted the bank about commercial loan options and received a suggestion for a combined loan. The entire process reflected the intergenerational differences in risk perception and Ye Mingxuan's active coordination.

subevent.name: Collect and screen home-buying information in advance
subevent.description: After work, Ye Mingxuan used online real estate platforms and real estate agent mini-programs to screen housing listings in and around Xiqing District, Tianjin, focusing on the prices, areas, and surrounding amenities of relatively new second-hand homes. He saved the suitable property information to his phone notes to prepare for a family discussion.
subevent.location: Home in Xiqing District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Family meeting to discuss buying a house
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Ye Mingxuan held a family meeting in the living room with his parents to discuss buying a home. His mother, Wang Xiulan, strongly opposed a commercial loan, worried that a monthly mortgage payment of 6,000 to 7,000 yuan would overwhelm the family; his father, Ye Jianguo, took out a calculator and rationally planned the down payment (using family savings and his father's pension) and repayment options. Ye Mingxuan showed the property information he had collected and patiently explained the financial calculations to his mother. For the first time, he deeply felt the generational gap in risk perception, and he promised to manage the monthly payments carefully.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Xiqing District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Overnight preparation of property comparison table and financial calculations
subevent.description: After the family discussion, Ye Mingxuan returned to his room, turned on his computer, and made a detailed Excel spreadsheet comparing residential properties, including unit price, total price, down payment ratio, monthly repayment amount, provident fund loan limit, and the difference from a commercial loan. He also simulated the monthly payment pressure under three different down payment ratios. He calculated over and over and did not finish until 1 a.m., providing a quantitative basis for the next decision.
subevent.location: Home study room, Xiqing District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Consult the bank about commercial loan options.
subevent.description: The next day at noon, Ye Mingxuan used his lunch break to call Zhang Wei, the wealth management manager at China Merchants Bank Tianjin Branch, to ask about current commercial loan interest rate policies, early repayment conditions, and required materials. Zhang Wei suggested a combined loan (provident fund + commercial loan) to lower the overall interest rate, and made an appointment to discuss the specific plan at the bank on the weekend. Ye Mingxuan noted down the key information and updated the previous calculation sheet.
subevent.location: Tianjin - China Merchants Bank Tianjin Branch (Xiqing District)

name: Accompanied his mother to watch the stage play "Thunderstorm" to strengthen the bond between mother and son.
description: On the morning of September 13, after finishing the volunteer woodworking class at the community center, Ye Mingxuan was given two tickets to the classic People's Art Theatre play "Thunderstorm." On the evening of September 14, although he was not enthusiastic about theater, he remembered that his mother Wang Xiulan had been a theater fan when she was young, so he accompanied her to Tianjin Grand Theatre to watch it. During the three-hour performance, his mother watched with rapt attention, occasionally commenting in a low voice, and Ye Mingxuan gradually became drawn into the plot as well. After the show, his mother sighed, "It's been years since I've enjoyed a play this much." The outing deepened the emotional bond between mother and son through shared memories.

At the same time, he put the 800 yuan spent on new house decoration materials into the month's expenses. After checking the total expenses (14800 yuan) against the income (14000 yuan), he found overspending, so he adjusted the flexible spending cap to 1200 yuan to balance the budget and saved the budget plan.

name: Discovered a Republic of China error nickel coin while organizing ancient coins
description: On February 16, Ye Mingxuan took out a coin collection box, a magnifying glass, and the "Catalog of Chinese Machine-Made Silver Dollars" from his study, preparing to sort the inexpensive ancient coins he had bought earlier in the year. On the evening of February 17, while wiping and classifying the coins one by one, he found that the "A" on the front of a 25th year of the Republic of China Sun Yat-sen nickel coin had a slight missing stroke. After repeated observation under the light and comparison with the reference catalog through the magnifying glass, he preliminarily identified it as the rare "A missing stroke" mint error, and realized that the collection might contain a high-value item.

subevent.name: Took out the tools for sorting ancient coins.
subevent.description: Ye Mingxuan took out the coin collection box, magnifying glass, and tools such as the 'Catalog of Chinese Machine-Made Silver Dollars' from the study drawer, preparing to sort the inexpensive ancient coins purchased earlier this year.

subevent.description: Ye Mingxuan wiped and sorted the ancient coins one by one. When he picked up a Sun Yat-sen nickel coin from the 25th year of the Republic of China, he noticed that the stroke of the letter 'A' on the obverse was slightly incomplete, and he examined it repeatedly under the light.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Xiqing District - home study room

name: Li Na's UX criticism prompted Ye Mingxuan to improve the parametric tool interface overnight.
description: On August 3, 2025, Ye Mingxuan packaged the parametric tool he had developed into a demo version and arranged to meet his elementary school classmate Li Na, who was in Tianjin on a business trip. In the afternoon, the two met at a café in Nankai District. From a UX perspective, Li Na criticized the tool as looking like engineering commands and suggested making it usable even by the laziest colleague. That evening, Ye Mingxuan returned home in Xiqing District, revised the interface overnight, added graphical previews and drop-down menus, and made the tool intuitive and easy to use. The next morning, he verified that all functions worked correctly and backed up the new version, taking the first step toward productization.

subevent.name: Prepare the tool demo version and arrange the meetup
subevent.description: Ye Mingxuan packaged the developed parametric tool into a demo version and, through WeChat, made an appointment with his elementary school classmate Li Na, who was on a business trip in Tianjin, to meet that afternoon and discuss improvements to the tool.
subevent.location: Home study room, Xiqing District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Meeting with Li Na and accepting UX criticism.
subevent.description: Ye Mingxuan met up with Li Na at a restaurant in Tianjin. Li Na reviewed the initial version of the parametric tool and, from a user experience perspective, said bluntly that the tool felt more like engineering instructions than software. She suggested making it so that even the laziest colleague would want to use it, and gave specific directions for improvement.
subevent.location: A café in Nankai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Stayed up late modifying the interactive interface to add graphical preview and drop-down menus.
subevent.description: After the gathering, Ye Mingxuan returned home and, following Li Na's suggestion, worked late into the night modifying the tool's interactive interface, adding intuitive features such as graphical previews and drop-down menus. This made the tool easier to use and took the first step toward productization.
subevent.location: Home study room, Xiqing District, Tianjin

subevent.location: Home study room, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Emergency hospitalization due to seafood allergy. During the hospital stay, the diagnosis was confirmed and he learned first aid. After discharge, he taught his family how to use an epinephrine auto-injector.
description: On August 18, 2025, Ye Mingxuan had an acute allergic reaction after eating food containing seafood and was admitted to the emergency department of Tianjin Xiqing Hospital. On August 21, family doctor Liu Wentao and allergist Li Min held a consultation and confirmed that the allergen was seafood protein, and instructed Ye Mingxuan to learn how to self-inject with an epinephrine auto-injector. That evening, when his parents brought dinner, Ye Mingxuan told them about the first-aid process, and his mother Wang Xiulan was shaken by the thought of it. On August 22, his condition stabilized and he was discharged. The doctor prescribed an epinephrine auto-injector and reminded him of the precautions. On August 23, Ye Mingxuan bought the epinephrine auto-injector and went home to teach his parents to recognize the signs of an allergic attack and how to inject, making sure the family could perform first aid.

He then used Excel and Python to create a visualized health diary chart. name: Regularly go to the new apartment to ventilate and monitor formaldehyde levels, preparing for move-in
description: Ye Mingxuan prepared for moving into the new house in mid-August. On May 29, he bought a portable formaldehyde detector, planned a ventilation schedule, and created an Excel recording template. From June 1 to June 21, he went to the new house every 2-3 days (usually after work on Tuesdays and Fridays or on weekends), opened the windows to ventilate for 2 hours, and used the detector to record formaldehyde readings in each room. His father occasionally accompanied him to discuss soft furnishing plans. On July 1, he summarized and analyzed the June data, confirmed safety, and decided to move in mid-August.

subevent.location: New house, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakthrough in key engine component technology
description: On November 1, 2025, Ye Mingxuan and team members including Gao Zhiyuan, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang conducted the final design review and prepared experimental materials. From November 2 to 4, he spent three consecutive days in the laboratory performing fatigue tests, parameter optimization, and final verification. The fatigue life of the new part exceeded the expected target by 25%, and on the afternoon of the 4th, they announced the technical breakthrough a success. On November 5, he reported the results to project manager Wang Peng and department leaders, and celebrated with a team dinner. This achievement laid the core technical foundation for his subsequent promotion.

name: Prepare for the “Parent-Child Lantern Making” hands-on activity at the New Year's Day Lantern Festival.
description: From December 27 to 30, at the invitation of the community center, Ye Mingxuan began preparing the "Parent-Child Lantern Making" experience activity for the New Year's Day Lantern Festival. He first communicated with the community to determine needs, designed connector blueprints and purchased materials, then used the lathe to batch pre-process 50 connector pieces for lantern frames (cylindrical plug-in pieces with holes), so that on-site assembly would be simple, greatly reducing the difficulty for children. This was the first time the lathe served public welfare. When the community leader learned of this, they proactively proposed adding a "Mini Lathe Demonstration" segment to the intangible cultural heritage workshop, further broadening the boundaries of woodworking public welfare.

subevent.description: Ye Mingxuan went to the community center and discussed the specific requirements for the parent-child lantern-making experience activity at the New Year's Day Lantern Festival with Director Wang, the person in charge. They determined that the number of lanterns would be 50, along with the assembly method and on-site schedule.
subevent.location: Tianjin Xiqing District - Zhongbei Town Community Service Center

subevent.description: According to the activity requirements, Ye Mingxuan designed a drawing of the lantern frame connector (a cylindrical plug with holes) using CAD software at home, and went to the hardware market to buy acrylic rods and tools.
subevent.location: Xiqing District, Tianjin - home study

name: 3D Printing Basics: From Buying Equipment to Learning Modeling and Printing Practice
description: On April 15, 2025, Ye Mingxuan researched and ordered an entry-level 3D printer and consumables. On April 21, after receiving the printer, he unboxed and inspected it, and started installing and learning 3D modeling software. Over the following days, he learned basic modeling operations through videos and practiced designing simple parts. In early May, he independently designed a practical storage box model and did his first 3D print. After adjusting the model and parameters to address problems such as warping and stringing, he printed a second time. Finally, on May 10, he summarized his learning outcomes and planned future DIY tool projects.

subevent.name: Researched and ordered a 3D printer and consumables
subevent.description: At home, browsed e-commerce platforms on the computer to compare the performance and prices of several entry-level 3D printers (such as the Creality Ender-3 V2), selected a model suitable for DIY part printing, placed the order and paid, and also purchased matching PLA filament and tools.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home study

subevent.name: Received the 3D printer and unboxed it for inspection.
subevent.description: Received the 3D printer parcel delivered by courier. Opened the box in the living room to check that the printer body and accessories were intact, read the quick start guide, moved the printer to the workbench, powered it on, and tested basic operation.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home living room

subevent.name: Install 3D modeling software and get familiar with the interface.
subevent.description: Download and install free 3D modeling software such as Fusion 360 or TinkerCAD on your computer, and follow the built-in tutorials to learn the basic interface layout, view controls (rotate/pan/zoom), and common toolbars.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home study

subevent.name: Learned basic modeling operations: extrude and revolve.
subevent.description: Watch teaching videos on Bilibili or the official website to learn creating sketches (lines, circles, rectangles), constraining dimensions, and using extrude and revolve commands to generate simple 3D solids (such as cylinders, cubes), and complete simulation exercises.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home study

subevent.name: Practice creating compound geometry models.
subevent.description: Use the weekend to design a 3D model of a small part (such as a phone stand) by combining multiple basic geometric solids (Boolean operations), reinforcing extrude, revolve, chamfer, and shell operations.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home study

subevent.name: Designing the first practical part: a simple storage box.
subevent.description: Based on the modeling techniques learned earlier, independently design a small storage box model with a drawer (sized to fit the workbench tools), export it in STL format, and preset the slicing parameters.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home study

subevent.name: Conducted the first 3D printing and observed the results.
subevent.description: Transfer the sliced G-code to the 3D printer, level the heated bed, load PLA filament, and start printing; monitor the entire printing process, record any issues (such as warping or stringing), and after printing is complete, remove the part and check surface quality and dimensional accuracy.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home workbench

subevent.name: Adjust the model based on print feedback and print a second time.
subevent.description: Analyze the cause of the first print failure, modify the local wall thickness of the model or add chamfers, adjust the slicing parameters (raise the heated bed temperature, enable the brim), re-slice and print the improved version, and compare the results of the two prints.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home workbench

subevent.name: Summarize learning outcomes and plan subsequent DIY tool projects.
subevent.description: Organized study notes and printed samples, and showed the printed results to his parents in the family group chat; combined with his woodworking hobby, he planned the next step of learning complex surface modeling to prepare for designing self-made woodworking fixtures and molds.
subevent.location: Tianjin - home living room

name: Led the engine technology breakthrough and resolved the supplier crisis
description: On September 1, Ye Mingxuan was appointed to lead the technical breakthrough team for key components of the new engine. The team included Li Xiang and a new employee. After the project started, the special steel provided by a key supplier was found during testing on September 8 to have seriously substandard performance, stalling the project. Ye Mingxuan worked overtime late into the night and contacted multiple new suppliers without success. Through a former colleague, Zhou Tao, as a connection, he found a professional 3D printing factory to urgently produce test samples. On September 18, the 3D-printed replacement parts passed testing, and the project got back on track. In mentoring the new employee, Ye Mingxuan also came to appreciate the difficulty of passing on technical expertise.
